correctness.rationale: An independent Python-standard-library certificate constructs all 3468 nonempty simplices, verifies boundary composition exactly, and shows ranks (120,491) for (d2,d3) over F3 and (120,492) over F101. Rank bounds imply dim H2(F3)=1 and H2(Q)=0. The four-vertex carrier lemma follows from simplicial 2-cycle edge-incidence equations. Exhaustive direct reductions of every missing-tetrahedron boundary in im(d3 mod3) show 476 essential and 34 null supports in exactly six affine orbits; all 2380 four-vertex subsets are covered. No integral-order computation is presented as a novel independent certificate.

value.rationale: The Paley-17 neighborhood complex has a distinguished three-primary degree-two torsion direction; locating its shortest geometric generators is intrinsically motivated by the existing Moore-space result. The exact minimum four-vertex support, five essential affine orbits with 476 carriers, and the unique 34-member null orbit among otherwise identical induced spheres expose structural information not implied by the Betti numbers, homotopy type or abstract homology action. The classification is natural, complete at its sharp threshold and non-routine.
